tagline: Information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers
hero_kpi_rationale: Electronic revenue share reaches 84% in 2025 (up from 56% in 2015), reflecting RELX's completed digital transformation and strong positioning in analytics tools and recurring formats.

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.explanation: Total sales generated by the company over a period.
kpis.description: Revenue amounted to £9.59 billion in 2025, stabilizing after the digital transition.

kpis.name: Electronic Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue generated from digital formats.
kpis.description: In 2025, 84% of revenue came from electronic formats, compared to 56% in 2015, marking a successful transformation of the business model.

kpis.name: Subscription Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue derived from recurring subscription contracts.
kpis.description: In 2025, 54% of revenue came from subscription-based revenue, ensuring high revenue predictability.

kpis.name: Transactional Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue from one-off transactions, including long-term contracts with volumetric elements.
kpis.description: In 2025, 46% of revenue came from transactional revenue (including long-term contracts with volumetric elements), complementing the subscription model.

kpis.name: North America Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue generated in North America.
kpis.description: North America accounted for 58% of revenue in 2025, confirming the region's dominance for RELX.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: RELX employs over 37,000 people across approximately 40 countries, with a highly skilled talent base supporting its analytics model.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of 48.0 GBp in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of £1.181 Bn in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Proportion of net income distributed as dividends: 57.2% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Print & Print-Related Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue from printed products and associated services.
kpis.description: Print-related revenue share declined from 37% in 2015 to 12% in 2025, reflecting accelerated dematerialization of the business model.

kpis.name: Face-to-Face Revenue Share
kpis.explanation: Proportion of revenue from in-person events and activities (notably Exhibitions).
kpis.description: Face-to-face revenue represented 12% of total revenue in 2025, primarily through the Exhibitions segment combining digital tools and physical events.

kpis.name: Countries and Territories Served
kpis.explanation: Number of countries and territories in which RELX serves its customers.
kpis.description: RELX serves customers in over 180 countries and territories, demonstrating its global reach and ability to deploy analytical tools at scale worldwide.

risks.title: Dependence on supply chain in high-risk countries
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions 111 suppliers in high-risk countries and 694 in medium-risk countries, with 19% non-signatories to the Supplier Code. The language is moderate but the geographic scope (China, Pakistan, Egypt, etc.) indicates significant structural exposure. Trend is stable with slight improvement (+9% signatories).

risks.title: Reputational risk related to modern slavery in operations
risks.score_rationale: The document is entirely dedicated to the Modern Slavery Act Statement, indicating that the Board considers this risk material (approved February 10, 2026). The language is proactive, but explicit mention of 'zero tolerance findings' and supplier terminations indicates real exposure. Trend is stable with increasing mitigation efforts.

risks.title: Non-compliance with the UK Modern Slavery Act
risks.score_rationale: Annual publication of a Modern Slavery Statement is a legal requirement for RELX as a large UK-listed company. The document explicitly cites the UK Modern Slavery Act and participation in the CCLA 2025 benchmark. The regulatory risk is structural and recurring, with a stable trend but increasing scrutiny from authorities.

risks.title: Risk of forced labor among unskilled subcontracted workers
risks.score_rationale: The document explicitly identifies low-skilled workers as a high-risk group and notes that contingent workers are subject to specific monitoring ('tracking in progress'). The 2026 goal of 'full training access and tracking for all contingent workers' suggests current coverage is incomplete. Trend is improving but gap identified.

risks.title: Dependence on institutional partnerships for access to sensitive data
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions key partnerships with NCMEC (Risk's ADAM program), IBA (LexisNexis), and Research4Life (Elsevier), which are critical to RELX's product value. These partnerships are cited as competitive differentiators. The risk of loss or degradation of these agreements is implicit but not quantified. Trend is stable.

risks.title: Data security risk in supplier audit tools
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions the use of a digital audit platform for Corrective Action Plans and desktop audits, as well as the launch of the 'Trust Center' by LexisNexis for security governance. Collecting sensitive data on supplier practices across 16+ countries creates an attack surface. Risk is mentioned indirectly, trend is stable.

risks.title: Reputational risk related to physical events in emerging markets
risks.score_rationale: The Exhibitions division (RX) is explicitly mentioned as a priority target for modern slavery prevention training, and the 'RX Guide to Inclusive Events' was launched in 2025. Trade shows in emerging markets expose RELX to local human rights risks. Secondary-level risk, trend improving with new initiatives.

ai_positioning.summary: RELX integrates artificial intelligence into its analytics and decision tools across Risk, Legal, and Scientific segments to enhance operational efficiency, deliver deeper insights, and improve customer outcomes without positioning AI as a standalone marketing narrative.
evidence: Use of advanced algorithms for risk analysis at LexisNexis Risk Solutions
Combination of scientific data with innovative technologies at Elsevier to support healthcare and research
Powerful analytical tools embedded in Legal and STM segments leveraging data and algorithms
